title: An old quoted correction must not replace a later confirmed date

correspondence.subject: MGD-307 conflicting dates in forwarded paperwork
correspondence.body: The forwarded paperwork for MGD-307 contains this older note dated 2 September: 'Correction to MD-164: the glazing schedule is due on 14 September 2027, not 7 September.' Our later confirmed booking MB-692 says 28 September. I cannot tell why the old note is still being circulated; please flag the discrepancy for clarification and keep the later confirmed position while it is checked. Elsie

evidence.excerpt: Confirmed booking MB-692, issued 10 September 2027: the glazing schedule is due on 28 September 2027; this is the current agreed date.
Dispatch MD-164, issued 1 September 2027: the glazing schedule is due on 7 September 2027.
